database.description: Videos, people, tags, and watch history
database.label: Database
database.note: All of Peach is here. Deleting it empties the collection

downloads.description: Covers, avatars, label logos, and page caches from metadata sites

logs.note: Only archived logs and crash reports are removed; logs in use are kept

playback.description: Transcoded copies of videos the browser can't play directly

playback.note: Videos are transcoded again when played

previews.description: Contact sheets, posters, and scrubber previews made from video frames

records.description: Resume points, auto-repair receipts, review lists, and archives
records.label: Task & review records

sources.description: Metadata and raw records imported from other apps
sources.label: Imported data

thumbnails.description: Small copies of covers and avatars shown in lists and grids
thumbnails.label: Thumbnails
thumbnails.note: Recreated from local covers as you browse

tools.description: FFmpeg, face recognition, and other programs for playback, frames, and recognition
tools.label: Media tools
